question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 J 组：阿根廷 vs 奥地利（90 分钟三路赛果）
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group J: Argentina vs Austria (three-way result, 90 minutes)
one_liner_cn: Elo 差距近 300 分使卫冕冠军阿根廷显著占优；梅西伤情管理与奥地利体系稳定只支持小幅修正。
one_liner_en: A near-300-point Elo gap makes defending champions Argentina clear favourites; Messi's fitness management and Austria's stability justify only a small adjustment.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 285 分（2115 vs 1830），Davidson 统计模型给出阿根廷约 2/3 的基线胜率
key_reasons.en: A 285-point Elo gap (2115 vs 1830) yields a ~2/3 baseline win probability for Argentina in the Davidson model

key_reasons.cn: 梅西 5 月下旬腿筋肌肉过载，Scaloni 确认已恢复训练并将任队长，但 38 岁+腿筋史构成不确定项
key_reasons.en: Messi suffered hamstring muscular overload in late May; Scaloni confirmed he is back training and will captain, but age 38 plus hamstring history is an uncertainty

key_reasons.cn: 奥地利 1998 年以来首进世界杯但 Rangnick 体系成熟，Alaba 伤愈回归任队长，阵容齐整
key_reasons.en: Austria's first World Cup since 1998, but Rangnick's system is mature and a fit David Alaba returns as captain

method_note: Market-blind: Elo snapshot -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) -> bounded evidence adjustment (-2pp Argentina, +1pp draw, +1pp Austria; cap ±8pp) -> renormalized. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity and evidence thinness. No betting/prediction-market data used.
